entry.content: Team tasks let you share recurring work with teammates in ChatGPT. Set a task to run on a schedule or supported trigger, using approved company tools. Authorized teammates can review results and update instructions together, so maintaining the task doesn’t depend on one person. For example, your team can post a weekly project update with progress, blockers, and next steps to an approved Slack channel. entry.title: OpenAI Marketplace for enterprise customers
entry.content: We’re announcing OpenAI Marketplace in beta, a program that lets eligible enterprise customers apply part of their OpenAI commitment toward qualifying partner software. The initial program is managed directly with OpenAI and participating partners, with eligibility determined for each customer, product, and purchase. Customers contract with and receive invoices from the partner. You can browse partner products and express interest, but there is no self-service checkout.

entry.title: Connect approved tools for team work
entry.content: ChatGPT Business and Enterprise workspace administrators can configure app connections for teams to use with approved tools and recurring tasks. A team owner can enable eligible workspace connections for the team, so each teammate does not need to connect the same provider account separately. The connected provider account determines which information and actions a task can access. Sharing a plugin and granting access to an app connection are separate settings.

Pages follow Space’s availability and sharing settings. Sharing a Page does not give other people access to your private chats or memory; information added to the Page is visible to people who can view it. Space

entry.title: Work with interactive plugin extensions
entry.content: Plugins can now include interactive panels, sidebar views, and viewers or editors for supported file types. Work with an app alongside your conversation, select the information you want ChatGPT to use, or complete a form provided by the plugin. Plugins still require their applicable account connections and workspace permissions. Learn more about plugins in ChatGPT and Codex .

entry.title: Use your ChatGPT allowance in participating apps
entry.content: Eligible Plus and Pro users can authorize participating apps to use their ChatGPT model allowance without creating an API key. Choose which apps can use your allowance and set an app-specific limit. Usage counts toward your existing plan allowance; connecting an app does not add more usage. This is a limited preview with participating integrations. Using purchased credits requires a separate opt-in. A partner may still charge for its own product or services. entry.title: Start automations from connected-app events
entry.content: Supported plugins can use MCP events to start an automation when something changes in a connected app. Describe what you want ChatGPT to follow and what it should do with matching updates—for example, prepare a summary when new information arrives in a channel you have asked it to monitor. The connected account must have access to the event and any information used by the task. Learn more about connected apps in ChatGPT .

entry.title: Sign in to other products with ChatGPT
entry.content: You can use your ChatGPT account to sign in to participating products without creating another password. The product receives your name, email address, and profile picture if you have one. Signing in does not share your ChatGPT conversations or memory; you approve any additional access separately. Available to signed-in ChatGPT users, subject to organization settings. Sign-in access is separate from permission to use your ChatGPT plan allowance. Learn more about Sign in with ChatGPT .

entry.title: Share your profile and showcase your Sites
entry.content: Your ChatGPT profile now brings together your bio, activity, and Sites you choose to showcase. Personal profiles are private by default. You can make yours public and share its link with other people signed in to ChatGPT. Shared profiles do not show conversation titles or content. Profile sharing and the Sites showcase are available on web and desktop. In Business workspaces, administrators control whether coworkers can view workspace profiles. entry.content: Codex Security Cloud can scan GitHub repositories on demand or on a schedule, while ongoing checks review new commits. Codex investigates findings, removes duplicates, and prepares proposed fixes for review. Scans run in the cloud and can continue after you close your laptop. Access requires the applicable workspace permissions, repository setup, and billing configuration. Existing Codex Security customers opt in before paid usage. entry.title: Review pull requests with Codex
entry.content: Use Code Review in Codex to read pull-request summaries and diffs, review findings, and discuss changes. Open a pull request, inspect the changes, and ask Codex to explain a section or help address a potential issue before sharing feedback. Available through the Code Review plugin on supported desktop and web experiences. Access to a repository follows your connected account and workspace permissions. Learn more about Code Review .

entry.title: Pro 200 subscriptions
entry.content: Pro 200 is available for new subscriptions again at $200/month. Included usage allowances are changing. Users affected by these changes will receive an email with additional details. The monthly price remains $200. Learn more about Pro plans and existing subscriptions .

entry.title: Organize your work in ChatGPT Space
entry.content: Space brings your Pages, files, and related work together in ChatGPT. Create a space for a project, add the material you need, and share it with other people so you can keep building on the same work. Space replaces Library for accounts with access; your existing Projects remain separate. Available to eligible Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in the ChatGPT desktop app and on the web. Sharing in managed workspaces follows your organization’s settings; Enterprise sharing is an opt-in preview.

The Meetings plugin takes notes for you based on what’s said in the meeting and saves personalized summaries with action items in ChatGPT Space. You can keep them private or share them with your team, then ask ChatGPT to update a project plan or draft a follow-up. Audio is deleted once your notes are ready and can’t be accessed or replayed. entry.content: Codex Cloud lets you start and continue coding tasks from desktop, web, or mobile using reusable environments with your project’s repositories, tools, and dependencies. entry.title: An agent used DNS to reach an external chatbot
